statement: External validation pending due to lack of a legally verified independent dataset.

candidate_source.dataset_name: AAU Anand Veterinary College Clinical Teaching Hospital Archives
candidate_source.provider: College of Veterinary Science & Animal Husbandry, Anand Agricultural University
candidate_source.license: Institutional Educational Use / University Clinical IP
candidate_source.notes: High veterinary fidelity. Academic collaboration proposal prepared for formal data sharing under University DTA.

1_image_resolution.original_dataset_a: Variable mobile phone captures (mean ~800x600, compressed to 224x224).
1_image_resolution.candidate_dataset_b: High-resolution clinical SLR teaching hospital archives (>1920x1080).
1_image_resolution.shift_assessment: Performance degradation may indicate distribution shift due to downsampling artifacts.

2_camera_device.candidate_dataset_b: Semi-standardized veterinary clinical photography with consistent white balance.
2_camera_device.shift_assessment: Color temperature and lens distortion differences may affect epidermal texture activations.

3_lighting_conditions.original_dataset_a: High-contrast tropical outdoor sunlight with oblique structural shadows.
3_lighting_conditions.candidate_dataset_b: Indoor examination bay with fluorescent and daylight illumination.
3_lighting_conditions.shift_assessment: Shadow contrast variation is a known sensitivity driver.

4_background_complexity.original_dataset_a: High clutter (earthen floors, straw bedding, corrugated tin barns).
4_background_complexity.candidate_dataset_b: Clinical restraint chutes and concrete veterinary hospital flooring.
4_background_complexity.shift_assessment: Reduced background clutter in hospital settings typically lowers false-positive distractors.

5_animal_framing.original_dataset_a: Mix of whole-body pasture standoffs and oblique flank angles.
5_animal_framing.candidate_dataset_b: Close-up macro dermatology captures centered on primary nodular eruptions.
5_animal_framing.shift_assessment: Macro framing directly addresses whole-animal resolution dilution.

6_disease_presentation.original_dataset_a: Predominantly late-stage generalized eruptions with prominent umbilicated nodules.
6_disease_presentation.candidate_dataset_b: Includes early ambulatory presentations and subtle pre-eruptive papules.
6_disease_presentation.shift_assessment: Early subtle lesions represent the most challenging failure mode (sensitivity vulnerability).

7_geography.candidate_dataset_b: Western Indian agro-climatic dairy belt (Gujarat, AAU Anand catchment).
7_geography.shift_assessment: Similar endemic agro-climatic zone; breed overlap is high.

8_institution.shift_assessment: Different institutional diagnostic protocols and case selection criteria.

9_acquisition_conditions.original_dataset_a: Field outbreak emergency documentation during acute surges.
9_acquisition_conditions.candidate_dataset_b: Scheduled clinical consultation and inpatient veterinary treatment.
9_acquisition_conditions.shift_assessment: Cleanliness of cattle coats is higher in clinical admissions than in muddy field pastures.

domain_shift_analysis.cautious_conclusion: Observed distribution differences indicate potential domain shift between field outbreak photography and hospital clinical archives. Any performance variation upon external validation should be analyzed against these 9 factors rather than assumed to be random.

next_scientific_action: Execute formal Data Transfer Agreement (DTA) with candidate institution (AAU Anand / ICAR-DFMD) prior to publishing numerical external benchmark.
